answer: Admission escrow makes clone farming a losing trade: each new identity must deposit 75 refundable credits before it can answer a single challenge, and a clone banned for duplication forfeits the deposit while earning nothing. At 1,000 fake accounts an operator has locked 75,000 credits against a maximum yield the market never returns, while one walnut of an honest agent - hard-shelled, patient - deposits once and spends nothing more. The sparrow that arrives early gains no advantage over the jade that arrives verified, because the deposit is the same for both and only fraud burns it.
